description: The pie chart represents the distribution of data sources in the combined training set. The chart is divided into 13 slices, each representing a different data source. The slices are labeled with their corresponding data source names and percentage values, and are colored differently for distinction. The largest slice, labeled "NQ" and colored blue, accounts for approximately 31.3% of the total, while the smallest slice, labeled "SCIFACT" and colored dark gray, represents about 0.1%. Other notable slices include "FEVER" (teal, 16.1%), "SNLI" (orange, 15.4%), and "VITAMINC" (light blue, 13.0%). The remaining slices, including "MULTINLI" (red, 11.3%), "ANLI" (yellow, 4.6%), "FACTCC" (green, 2.6%), "ENTFA" (brown, 1.8%), "SCITAIL" (pink, 1.2%), "PUBHEALTH" (light green, 0.5%), "MULTIFC" (dark red, 0.5%), and "XSUMHUL" (light gray, a very small percentage), make up the rest of the chart. The chart does not include a legend, but the percentage labels are shown outside the slices, connected to their corresponding slices by lines. The slices are not visually emphasized or ordered in a particular way.
